label: Живущий
description: A 10-sentence card for живущий, the present active participle of жить.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine nominative. Живущий comes from жить via the present stem живут plus -щ- and an ending. It agrees with masculine сосед and means the neighbour who lives nearby.
Strategic focus: Feminine nominative. The feminine ending -ая lets живущая agree with тётя, marking the aunt who lives alone.
Strategic focus: Neuter nominative. Живущее takes the neuter ending -ее to match the neuter noun существо, describing the creature living in the river.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative. The plural ending -ие joins живущие to друзья, picking out the friends who live in the city.
Strategic focus: Masculine accusative. With the animate object дядю the participle takes -его, so живущего agrees in gender, number and case as the uncle I visit.
Strategic focus: Feminine genitive. Живущей carries the feminine genitive ending to agree with семьи, marking whose house it is — the house of the family living here.

missions.phrase: Я пишу живущему за границей брату.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine dative. The dative object брату pulls живущему into the dative -ему ending, naming the brother who lives abroad and to whom I write.

missions.phrase: Я знаком с живущим напротив врачом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine instrumental. After знаком с the noun врачом stands in the instrumental, and живущим takes the matching instrumental ending to agree with the doctor living opposite.

missions.phrase: Мы говорим о живущей рядом подруге.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine prepositional. The preposition о governs the prepositional case, so подруге and живущей both take prepositional endings as the friend we speak about.

missions.phrase: Живущие в деревне люди встают рано.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Plural nominative paraphrase. Живущие в деревне люди unfolds as люди, которые живут в деревне — people who live in the village. The participle folds that который-clause into one agreeing word.
